info.title: Suno Word-Level Lyrics Timestamps (Beta Draft)
info.description:
Unreleased draft. This endpoint is under development and validation. Examples do not establish production availability. Final pricing, access scope, and release date will be announced after confirmation.

Retrieve word start and end times for a completed Suno song owned by the current account, for player highlighting or lyric videos. This endpoint provides word-level data and does not provide separate line-level timestamps.

post.summary: Fetch or read word-level lyrics timestamps for one song
post.description:
Unreleased draft. This endpoint is under development and validation. Examples do not establish production availability. Final pricing, access scope, and release date will be announced after confirmation.

Submitting the same source_task_id + result_id again under the same account reads the latest operation state or saved result. Changing an API key or Idempotency-Key does not create another purchase. The API key must remain valid and authorized. During the supported retention period, saved purchased results can be read for free, including when the account balance is zero. A successful alignment that meets the delivery criteria is charged once per song after it is saved. Definite failures, instrumental songs, and unusable alignment results are not charged; reserved funds are returned. The initial release does not deliver partial or invalid lyric alignment; it returns alignment_unavailable without a charge.

Use [Task Details](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail): source_task_id is the EvoLink music generation task id; result_id is the selected song's result_id in result_data. Different songs returned by one generation are processed separately. You do not need to generate the song again.

The first retrieval requires the source song to remain accessible through its original generation account. Existing songs can be requested, but access is not guaranteed for every historical song or for songs older than 14 days. Generated-file retention does not establish a timestamp lookup lifetime. Instrumental songs have no lyrics to align. Missing words, repeated choruses, and changes in the vocal performance can affect timing; review the audio before exporting a finished video.

After a 202 response, wait for Retry-After and submit the same source_task_id and result_id to this endpoint again. Processing and reconciliation do not automatically submit another upstream request. The same two IDs can recover the operation even if the first HTTP response was lost. GET /v1/tasks/{id} reads the music generation task, not this timestamp operation.

upstream_unknown means that the first request outcome is still being reconciled; it is not a confirmed failure. The operation is resolved within a bounded reconciliation window. If the outcome cannot be confirmed, reserved funds are returned and the terminal record is retained. Ordinary repeated requests do not create another purchase; changing Idempotency-Key does not authorize another charge.

The body must be one JSON object containing only source_task_id and result_id, with no extra fields or trailing JSON. The full request body is limited to 4096 bytes. Both IDs must be non-empty and have no leading or trailing whitespace; source_task_id is limited to 50 UTF-8 bytes and result_id to 128 UTF-8 bytes.

A 202 response has one of preparing, calling, upstream_unknown, awaiting_settlement, or refund_pending and Retry-After: 2. Submit the same two IDs to read its latest state. completed returns 200 with words; failed and unknown_refunded return 422 with error. Every operation response includes operation_id, source_task_id, result_id, cached, and billing_status. The fund state is not_charged, reserved, refunded, or paid; use billing_status to determine whether funds were held, charged, or returned. Errors before an operation exists contain error only.

200.description: Alignment is completed and saved. cached=true means an existing result was read with no charge for this request.

202.description: The operation is still processing or its outcome is being reconciled. Wait for Retry-After, then check again with the same two IDs.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before checking the same operation again.

default.description: Parameter, authorization, source-song state, support scope, quota, alignment availability, or service error. The response contains a stable error.code. If an operation is unresolved, check again with the same two IDs instead of creating another purchase.

422.description: The operation ended without delivered timestamps (failed or unknown_refunded), or the source is instrumental. Terminal operation responses include billing_status, which may be not_charged or refunded. Repeating the same request reads the terminal result and does not start another purchase.

error.message: Upstream outcome could not be confirmed; reservation refunded; no automatic retry
Instrumental songs have no lyric timestamps.

400.description: Invalid body, IDs, unsupported source, or endpoint.

401.description: API key is missing, invalid, or expired.

403.description: The API key lacks permission or cannot start a new paid request.

404.description: The source task or selected song was not found for this account.

409.description: The source music generation task is not completed.

503.description: New retrieval is unavailable, the original account cannot be verified, pricing is unavailable, or a temporary service error occurred.

bearerAuth.description:
##All APIs require Bearer Token authentication##

**Get API Key:**

Visit [API Key Management Page](https://evolink.ai/dashboard/keys) to get your API Key

**Add to request header:**
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

source_task_id.description: Completed EvoLink Suno music generation task ID owned by the current account. Must be non-empty, contain no leading or trailing whitespace, and be at most 50 UTF-8 bytes.

result_id.description: The selected song's result_id within source_task_id. Do not use the overall task ID or an audio URL. Must be non-empty, contain no leading or trailing whitespace, and be at most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

operation_id.description: Stable ID of this timestamp operation, distinct from the music generation task ID.

cached.description: Whether an existing operation was reused. Re-reading an existing operation never starts a new purchase. For a completed result, true means this read is free; it does not mean the first alignment was free.

operation_id.description: Stable ID of this timestamp operation, distinct from the music generation task ID.

text.description: Lyrics fragments in performance order. Whitespace, newlines, or section labels may be retained; do not assume every item is an individual highlightable word.

start.description: Seconds from the beginning of the song, including decimals; null when no valid alignment is available.

end.description: Seconds from the beginning of the song, including decimals; null when no valid alignment is available.

aligned.description: Whether this fragment has a valid alignment. When false, do not treat start/end as accurate timestamps.

BillingStatus.description: Actual fund state: not_charged means no charge was reserved for this operation; reserved means funds are held pending the outcome; paid means the charge has been confirmed; refunded means reserved funds have been returned. Check this field independently of status.

operation_id.description: Stable ID of this timestamp operation, distinct from the music generation task ID.

code.description: Stable error code. Common values include invalid_request, model_not_allowed, model_endpoint_mismatch, source_not_found, unsupported_source, source_not_completed, no_lyrics, source_account_unavailable, pricing_unavailable, timestamps_unavailable, insufficient_quota, upstream_failed, alignment_unavailable, and upstream_outcome_unknown.
